source.chapter_context: Ultramarines faction keyword on the shared-book profile; Chapter detachment and chapter-book interactions are not included in this shared-book scope.

fixed_data_comparison.scope: Fixed numeric, identity, keyword, loadout, composition, base, cost and mapped weapon-trait checks; executable ability interactions are covered separately by the dedicated local suite.

scope: One-model 100-point profile, one-copy cap, 40 mm base, source characteristics/keywords and no equipment-option rows.
Heavy Bolt Pistol, Severance Strike and Severance Sweep through Equipment and AttackPlan, preserving Close-quarters, Precision and Cleave 2.
Consolidated local catalog resolution and current Marine materialization for both players.
Support, Combat Doctrines, Veteran Bodyguard and Calgar’s Champion source ability registration.
All four source-listed Support targets (Bladeguard Veterans, Sternguard Veterans, Assault Intercessors and Victrix Honour Guard), plus rejection of unlisted Intercessors.
Kaius’s Support attachment appears in the preparation choices; Warlord eligibility is also checked.
Captain as Leader plus Kaius as Support forms the tested attached unit; Veteran Bodyguard grants Feel No Pain 4+ to the other Character, not Kaius.
Calgar’s Champion adds Hit and Wound rerolls of 1 against a Character target and does not apply against ordinary Infantry.
Kaius receives the active army Combat Doctrine through its registered source ability.
